translations.web: All the nations will serve him, his son, and his son’s son, until the time of his own land comes. Then many nations and great kings will make him their bondservant.
translations.bsb: All nations will serve him and his son and grandson, until the time of his own land comes; then many nations and great kings will enslave him.
